kind: selective MTP own-KV history; real drafter; forced target IDs only

method.default: off; no extra allocation unless explicitly configured
method.history: Own MTP K/V from validated complete SSD prefix plus accepted catch-up. Target contributes only selected logical positions.
method.selection: Sorted causal union of last8192 cells and final target QSA selected positions from accepted row.
method.graphs: Both families precaptured; same pool and MTP allocation in all arms. No allocation/recapture during measured decode.
method.coherence: Mirror writes into resident private pages, resolve misses from own host copy, reset on restore/fallback. Distinct-page capacity checked before resolve.
method.gate: After decode timer, compare private and host int8 codes and FP16 scales for all selected final-query cells; recent/distant coverage and overwritten resident cells required. Not an every-step check.

validation.gpu_gate: All six gate/B-smoke requests passed; selected recent and distant codes/scales equal own host, no fallback.

interpretation.decision: No convincing throughput gain; do not promote to Daily. Retain disabled research implementation and instrumentation.
limits: One hot BAB on each fixed continuation, not a general quality/speed result.
This treatment both adds remote history and reduces recent window32768 to8192; it does not isolate the contribution of either change.
All B chains used the selective path with exactly one map reset, no overflow or dense fallback.
Long arms omit postdecode KV checks; the gate/smoke perform them outside decode timing.
Expert cache contents and elasticity can change; raw events retained.
No free-generation, sampled or multi-chat performance/quality gate was run after the neutral result.
No end-to-end speedup can be inferred from fewer attention chunks or remote selected IDs alone.
